aiOverview.content: The 2026 Oscars ceremony, held on March 15, 2026, was approximately three and a half hours long. While the telecast was officially slated to run for three hours, Academy CEO Bill Kramer noted before the event that it was expected to last up to three and a half hours. Ceremony Duration and Timing The 98th Academy Awards began at 7:00 p.m. ET (4:00 p.m. PT) at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles. Typical Length: The ceremony usually runs between three and three and a half hours, concluding with the Best Picture announcement. 2026 Broadcast: Highlights and recaps from the event confirmed the total duration was roughly three and a half hours. Historical Context: While the show aims for a tight schedule, it has historically run over; the longest broadcast on record was in 2002 at 4 hours and 23 minutes. Event Schedule In addition to the main ceremony, extensive pre-show coverage took place: Official Red Carpet Show: Began at 6:30 p.m. ET (3:30 p.m. PT), 30 minutes before the main event. Early Coverage: Some networks began red carpet reporting as early as 3:30 p.m. ET, including a 90-minute "Countdown to Oscars" special on ABC. 2026 Oscar Key Information HostConan O'BrienDateMarch 15, 2026Start Time7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PTBest Picture WinnerOne Battle After Another
